instruction: Navigate to the flight status page on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United homepage to the flight status page. Evaluator uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric to verify URL contains the flight status path.

llm_judge_reasons: The metric function correctly accesses rules['expected'] directly - no parameter handling error
The URL pattern 'united.com/en/us/fly/travel/flight-status' correctly identifies the United Airlines flight status page
The getter get_active_tab_info() can successfully extract the active tab URL via accessibility tree and Playwright
Complete coverage - evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (navigate to flight status page)
Uses appropriate re.search() for flexible URL matching, handling variations like http/https, www prefix, query parameters, etc.
No postconfig needed - can verify active tab URL at any time after task completion
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider making the URL pattern more strict by anchoring it to avoid theoretical false positives. For example, use '^https?://(?:www\.)?united\.com/en/us/fly/travel/flight-status' to ensure the pattern matches the domain and path correctly, not just as a substring somewhere in a URL. This is a minor edge case and unlikely to cause issues in practice.
